notes: Run of 2026-11-23. Three Registry stories queued. The One Harrison full-building lease is published: it settles who occupies the whole renovated building, and confirms a deal the Chronicle reported on 2026-10-30 (declined then over its headline and because it had not closed). The Rox lease at 251 Rhode Island is a part-building tenant lease and is declined on the usual precedent. The availability roundup naming 211 Main, 301 Battery, 650 Townsend and Salesforce Tower is a market report of space on offer, not an event at any of them, and is declined. All three are paywalled after the lede.

findings.description: Newmark's tracking confirms an AI company has signed a 180,000 sq ft direct lease taking the whole of The Sobrato Organization's renovated One Harrison building. Paywalled after the lede; the date is publication, the article gives no signing date.

extra.earlier_report: San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-10-30 (news/items/sf-chronicle/2026-10-31.json, 2026-10-31-0001), declined: headline names an individual and the lease had not closed; that finding resolved to 101 Mission St., but the building is One Harrison.

citation.label: The Registry, “Prometheus Signs 180,000 SQFT Full-Building Lease at Sobrato’s One Harrison in San Francisco,” 23 November 2026

publish.note: Existing page (no seeding); headline entry added to historical_record and the homepage grid. A whole-building lease passes the ten-year test where a floor lease does not (cf. the Hinge Health precedent, 2026-09-10). The 2026-10-05 Hoodline entry is the reopening, a different event. No building fields: the article names a tenant, not the building's team.
